## Step 2: headless runner — built
New file `/Users/pablofernandez/Work/nutsack/crates/nutsack-tui/src/bin/real-sats-nutzap.rs`, wired via an explicit `[[bin]]` + `required-features = ["nmp-backend"]` in nutsack-tui's Cargo.toml (confirmed the default no-feature build still skips it). Drives the exact NutsackApp seam the acceptance harness uses: select_backend -> cashu.create -> nutzap.publish_info -> cashu.deposit_quote (prints bolt11, pauses/polls) -> cashu.complete_deposit -> nutzap.send. NUTSACK_NSEC is the only secret input, never logged, never file-read by this binary itself.

**Exact command for the owner:**
```
NUTSACK_NSEC=$(cat ~/.nsec-for-nutsack.txt) cargo run -p nutsack-tui --bin real-sats-nutzap --features nmp-backend
```
Optional overrides: MINT_URL, RELAYS (comma-separated), RECIPIENT_NPUB, AMOUNT_SATS (default 21). [...] First attempt hung indefinitely on `nutzap.publish_info` (real relays, not the acceptance harness's ephemeral local one). Root cause, confirmed independently with `nak req` against each relay: **`wss://relay.nostr.band` is unreachable from this network right now** ("connection took too long"), and NMP's self-publish path stalls waiting on it rather than failing that one relay fast. I'd defaulted RELAYS to the full `nutsack_core::CURATED_RELAYS` (5 relays, includes nostr.band) instead of the exact 4 you named — reverted the default to exactly damus.io/nos.lol/primal.net/purplepag.es (matches your spec precisely) and documented why in a code comment. Also fixed a real retry-loop bug I'd introduced: my `dispatch_and_await` bailed immediately on a bare `wait_for_result` timeout instead of retrying it the same as a `_nutsack_error` — real multi-relay publish round-trips are slower than the local ephemeral-relay case, so that needed to be retryable too. [...]      - Added a NUTSACK_RECOVER=1 mode branching: `let recover_mode = env::var("NUTSACK_RECOVER").map(|v| v == "1" || v.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true")).unwrap_or(false);` — recover mode does `cashu.recover` + polls total_balance() up to 45×2s + sends AMOUNT_SATS (not balance-buffer); else does create+deposit and sends `balance.saturating_sub(SEND_FEE_BUFFER)`.
     - Constants added: `const DEPOSIT_POLL_INTERVAL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(15);` `const DEPOSIT_RATE_LIMIT_BACKOFF: Duration = Duration::from_secs(45);` `const SEND_FEE_BUFFER: u64 = 5;`
     - wait_for_deposit: poll every 15s, on 429/"rate limit" back off 45s (fix for minibits rate-limiting the quote-status poll).
     - Surfaces `(mint quote_id: {quote_id})` for recoverability.
     - Env: NUTSACK_NSEC (required, never logged), MINT_URL (default https://mint.minibits.cash/Bitcoin), RECIPIENT_NPUB (default owner's npub), AMOUNT_SATS, RELAYS (default damus/nos.lol/primal/purplepag.es).
   - /Users/pablofernandez/Work/nutsack/Cargo.toml: nmp-wallet/nmp-nip60/nmp-native-runtime/nmp-core pinned to rev `c11cc81b520e9d87df57b36c653307c9fa2a5936` (current master with all fixes).
